flags.why: Bải means to thrust or stick forward, especially the lower lip, rather than to lengthen a rope ([dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_fr/B%E1%BA%A3i)).
flags.fix: to stick out; to thrust forward (especially the lower lip)

flags.why: The rope example uses bải as a verb for stretching, which is not its meaning.
flags.fix: Nó bải môi ra. = He stuck out his lower lip.

flags.why: This gloss describes buôn bán, whereas bán buôn means selling wholesale ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%C3%A1n_bu%C3%B4n)).
